question: Should OpenClaw accept this signed hosted marketplace feed trust surface once the prerequisite trust-stack PRs are ready, or pause until the feed trust contract is narrowed further?
rationale: This PR changes how OpenClaw verifies, persists, and displays trust for remote marketplace feed data, which is a security and operator-trust boundary that automation should not bless without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land after stack gates
options.body: Accept the direction only after the prerequisite PRs land or rebase cleanly, exact-head CI is green, and the PR body has current-head CLI proof.

options.title: Narrow the visibility slice
options.body: Keep the verifier/config/refresh work separate and ask this PR to expose only the CLI output after the trust-state shape is finalized.

options.title: Pause the trust surface
options.body: Hold or close this PR until maintainers finish the broader hosted feed trust contract and rollout policy.

recommendation.title: Land after stack gates
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only after the prerequisite PRs land or rebase cleanly, exact-head CI is green, and the PR body has current-head CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current marketplace/config/state surfaces and is the strongest available routing signal from current main history.
